UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: User-specific workspace configuration and default storefront URLs.

ownerId.description: The authenticated user UID owning this settings record.

displayName.description: Display name of the workspace owner.

defaultStoreBaseUrl.description: Default base URL for the Fourthwall shop (e.g., https://scienceofgifts.com).

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Canonical Fourthwall product record stored in the central Product Library.

ownerId.description: UID of the product library owner.

productUrl.description: Relative or absolute Fourthwall product URL (/products/...).

imageUrl.description: Product image URL or empty if relying on Fourthwall data-product-url auto-image.

price.description: Formatted or numeric price string (e.g., $24.90 or 24.90).

currency.description: ISO currency code such as USD.

productType.description: Product type classification (e.g., T-Shirt, Hoodie, Spiral Journal, Whiskey Glass).

category.description: Primary topic or deity/era category (e.g., Hades, Athena, Roman Republic).

tags.description: List of up to 20 searchable tags.

shortDescription.description: Short canonical summary of the product.

featuresSpecs.description: Verified product specifications, materials, weight, and print details.

archived.description: Whether the product is archived from active selection.

GiftGuide.title: GiftGuide
GiftGuide.description: Persistent gift-guide project metadata, canonical FAQ list, and JSON-LD schema settings.

ownerId.description: UID of the gift guide owner.

topic.description: Topic or theme (e.g., Greek Mythology, Roman History, World War II).

audience.description: Target recipient audience and editorial tone.

slug.description: URL slug for the gift guide page.

canonicalUrl.description: Full canonical URL of the gift guide page.

storeBaseUrl.description: Base storefront URL used for schema resolution.

collectionUrl.description: Main collection URL referenced in hubs and FAQs.

productCount.description: Count of distinct products referenced across sections.

schemaConfig.description: Structured configuration for BreadcrumbList and ItemList JSON-LD generation.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version of the guide document.

GuideSection.title: GuideSection
GuideSection.description: Independently editable and exportable section within a Gift Guide project.

anchorId.description: HTML section ID used for jump links (e.g., jump-quick-picks).

order.description: Numeric ordering index within the guide.

enabled.description: Whether this section is enabled in full-guide preview and export.

config.description: Structured template data specific to the section type.

HtmlProject.title: HtmlProject
HtmlProject.description: Persistent HTML Editor project containing the full edited HTML source, original imported HTML, base URL, and editor UI state.

name.description: Editable project name (e.g., History Gifts Guide).

originalHtml.description: Complete original imported HTML source preserved for restoration.

baseUrl.description: Optional base URL for resolving relative image URLs in preview.

editorState.description: Saved editor UI settings (viewMode, selectedBlockId, previewViewport, includeFourthwallCss).

/users/{userId}.description: User workspace preferences and default storefront configuration.

/users/{userId}/products/{productId}.description: Central reusable Product Library records owned by the user.

/users/{userId}/guides/{guideId}.description: Saved Gift Guide projects owned by the user.

/users/{userId}/guides/{guideId}/section.description: Configurable sections belonging to a specific Gift Guide project.

/users/{userId}/htmlProjects/{projectId}.description: Saved HTML Editor projects containing full HTML source and editor state.
